// divguard:path internal/codingagent/interactive_turn.go

package codingagent

import "strings"

// describe reproduces MODES-14: "used 401 tokens" reads as an auth failure.
func describe(err error) string {
	errStr := err.Error()
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(errStr, "401"): // want
		return "Authentication failed. Run /login."
	case strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "413"): // want
		return "Context overflow."
	}
	return errStr
}
